title: ever MIA|Pleated Glitter Ruffle Sleeve Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest style with our Pleated Diamond Linen Ruffle Sleeve Dress! This stunning piece features delicate ruffle sleeves and a flattering pleated design, perfect for dancing the night away. Crafted from lightweight linen, it ensures comfort while you celebrate love in style!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises diamond linen.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
